description: 3 INGREDIENT COOKIES  1 small ripe banana  1/2 cup natural peanut butter  1/2 cup vanilla protein powder Optional: chocolate chips and sea salt for topping Preheat oven to 350F. Mash the banana then fold in the peanut butter and protein powder. Scoop 6 cookies onto a parchment lined baking sheet. Dough will be sticky! Form circles as best as you can. Then top with chocolate chips if desired. Press down lightly with a fork. Bake for 10-12 minutes until edges are golden and center is no longer wet. Remove, top with sea salt and let cool for 5 minutes before transferring to a cooling rack. #healthycookie #chocolatechipcookie #cookierecipes #3ingredientcookie #healthycookierecipes
transcript: It is hard to believe these cookies only have 3 ingredients and each cookie has a whopping 13 grams of protein. Let's make them. We'll mash a very ripe banana, add in our natural peanut butter and vanilla protein powder, mix that into a cookie dough and scoop onto our baking sheet, add some chocolate chips if you like, and then bake for about 10 minutes for gooey, perfect cookies.
